prompt: Scan the Nifty 50 and tell me which stocks are breaking out with strong volume right now. Give me a proper trade plan with stop loss and target for any that look good.

assertions.text: Restricts the screen to the Nifty 50 universe as requested (not Nifty 500 or arbitrary stocks).
Screens specifically for breakout AND above-average volume.
Provides a full trade plan with stop-loss and ~5% target for any qualifying stock.
Includes market-regime context and a position-sizing reminder.
Returns no names if none qualify rather than forcing breakouts.
